description_good_justification: The README says what oas2mcp does and the problem it solves: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: The README covers installing and running it (https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/README.md), CONTRIBUTING.md how to report a bug, request a feature and contribute (https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_justification: Changes land as GitHub pull requests, as described in https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the requirements: pre-commit hooks, required CI checks, tests with every change, commit style and labels. https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: Installation, configuration and usage are documented at https://oas2mcp.therealm.tech/
documentation_interface_justification: The reference documents every option with its environment variable (https://oas2mcp.therealm.tech/reference/configuration/) and how operations map to MCP tools (https://oas2mcp.therealm.tech/reference/tools/); the chart README documents every Helm value (https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/charts/oas2mcp/README.md).
sites_https_justification: The repository (https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp), the documentation site (https://oas2mcp.therealm.tech/) and the image registry (ghcr.io) are served over HTTPS only.
english_justification: The code, documentation and issue tracker are in English.
repo_track_justification: Git records what changed, who changed it and when.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is a pull request merged to main between releases: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/commits/main
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version, set by https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/scripts/release.sh
version_tags_justification: Each release is an annotated git tag (vX.Y.Z for the application, chart-X.Y.Z for the chart): https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/tags
release_notes_justification: Each GitHub Release carries notes generated from the labels of its pull requests, grouped by https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/.github/release.yaml: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: Vulnerability fixes carry the security label and are listed under the Security section of the release notes (https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/.github/release.yaml).
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported on the GitHub issue tracker, as CONTRIBUTING.md says: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/issues
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private vulnerability reporting on GitHub, as SECURITY.md describes: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: cargo builds the binary and the Dockerfile the image: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/Taskfile.yml
build_floss_tools_justification: The Rust toolchain, Docker and Task are FLOSS.
test_justification: cargo test runs the unit tests, and an end-to-end suite runs against Keycloak; CONTRIBUTING.md documents both and quality.yaml runs them on every pull request. https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#running-the-tests
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Every pull request and every push to main runs the test suites: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: a new behaviour comes with tests, and a fix with a test that fails without it. https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#running-the-tests
warnings_justification: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings runs in pre-commit, locally and in CI: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
warnings_fixed_justification: Clippy denies warnings, so a warning fails the required pre-commit check.
crypto_published_justification: JWTs are signed and verified with the published JOSE algorithms RS*, PS*, ES256/384 and EdDSA only, and TLS goes through rustls.
crypto_call_justification: Cryptography is delegated to the jsonwebtoken (RustCrypto backend) and rustls crates; oas2mcp implements none.
crypto_floss_justification: jsonwebtoken, the RustCrypto crates and rustls are FLOSS.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithm is accepted: JWT verification is restricted to RS*, PS*, ES256/384 and EdDSA, and rustls offers no broken cipher.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No SHA-1 nor HMAC JWT algorithm is accepted, and rustls offers no CBC suite.
crypto_pfs_justification: Outbound TLS goes through rustls, which only negotiates ephemeral (EC)DHE key exchange.
crypto_random_justification: oas2mcp generates no key; the jti of its client assertions is a random UUID v4 drawn from the operating system's CSPRNG.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source, releases and images are delivered over HTTPS from GitHub and ghcr.io.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release images carry Sigstore provenance and SBOM attestations, checked with gh attestation verify as the README shows: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/README.md
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on, and pre-commit runs detect-private-key: https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
static_analysis_justification: Clippy runs in pre-commit on every change (https://github.com/therealm-tech/oas2mcp/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml), and CodeQL analyses every pull request and push to main.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security queries for Rust, Python and GitHub Actions.
static_analysis_often_justification: Clippy and CodeQL run on every pull request and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: oas2mcp is written in Rust, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: cargo test builds with debug assertions enabled.
